sentences.text:
% 17.11.2023  CRL.M.A. 31360/2023   (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Applications stand disposed of.

3. This is a bail application filed by the Petitioner Akshat @ Kaku s/o Sh. Vinod Kumar under Section 439 Cr.P.C. in respect of FIR No.420/2023 dated 01.05.2023 registered under Sections 323/341/304/34 IPC at P.S. Samaipur Badli.
5. Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
6. Status report be filed within two weeks from today.

7. List on 11.12.2023.
NOVEMBER 17, 2023/kks JYOTI SINGH, J
